t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Use the 1x multiplier rounds to work out which gnome is the higher value. Once you know this, use the 5x multiplier rounds to gain more points by choosing the gnome with the higher value.

vb_textbox.text: Try to determine which colour gnome provides the most mushrooms. It's best to do this on the 1x multiplier rounds, and then apply it to the 5x multiplier rounds in order to get the most points. Beware that the colour gnome that provides the most mushrooms seems to change throughout the game, so you need to keep testing it!
